title: Master the Future: Planning and Goal Setting

mc.q: Which one of the following is NOT a function of planning?
o: identifying a strategy for attaining goals

mc.q: In informal planning, goals are usually ________ shared with others in the organization.
Informal planning is ________.
In formal planning, ________.
o: specific goals covering a period of years are defined
to maximize flexibility, specific goals are never spelled out
very broad general goals are developed
goals may be written or unwritten

mc.q: Which of the following is NOT a reason for managers to plan?
o: to give direction to an organization

mc.q: Planning gives organizations direction that primarily helps them ________.
o: improve their image in the business community

mc.q: Planning gives organizations a way to deal with change that ________.
Organizations that don't formally plan may be more likely to have ________.
o: multiple departments performing the same task
a single department carrying out all company functions

mc.q: One effect of planning on managers is that it forces them to ________.
o: anticipate and consider the effect of change
ignore any change that doesn't directly affect them

mc.q: Managers who fail to plan may ________.
Which one of the following is a frequently cited criticism of formal planning?
o: Plans lock organizations into rigid goals and timetables.
Plans take too long to create.
Plans create resentment within different levels of the organization.
Formal planning works well only for smaller companies.

mc.q: One criticism of formal planning is that it focuses on how to beat the competition rather than how to ________.
o: have cordial relationships with the competition

mc.q: Failing to discard successful plans from the past is likely to lead to ________.
o: more success because conditions are unlikely to change in the future
failure because conditions are likely to change in the future
success because of the high quality of the plans
failure because of the low quality of the plans
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Criticism of planning: success can breed failure, because the environment changes.

mc.q: Studies of performance in organizations that plan have reached ________ with respect to the benefits of formal planning.
Studies of planning show that the key to successful planning is to make sure that the plans ________.
In studies in which formal planning did not lead to higher performance, ________ usually the culprit.
o: unforeseen events in the environment were

mc.q: In traditional goal setting, these individuals set goals.
In traditional goal setting, as they work their way from top management to employees, goals are likely to ________.
In a means-ends chain, a goal at a lower level ________.
o: is the bridge to a goal at the next higher level
is attained only after higher level goals are fulfilled
is separate from the goal at the next higher level
is ignored if goals at higher levels are attained

mc.q: In management by objectives (MBO), goals ________.
o: are jointly determined by employees and managers

mc.q: In addition to being made by both managers and employees, MBO goals must be ________.
o: nonspecific and open-ended with regard to time
specific and open-ended with regard to time
specific and include an explicit time limit
nonspecific and include no time limit

mc.q: MBO programs are usually largely successful because they ________.
o: give employees a sense of ownership of goals
free managers from the responsibility of setting goals
give managers a sense of ownership of goals
free employees from responsibility if goals are not met

mc.q:
Which goal-setting sequence is correct for the following steps?
1. Evaluate resources.
2. Identify goals.
3. Review the mission and job tasks.
4. Communicate goals.
5. Link rewards to goals.
6. Build feedback mechanisms.
The breadth of a plan refers to ________ concerns.
The specificity of a plan refers to ________ concerns.
Strategic plans address ________.
o: goals for a single branch of the organization
how overall goals are to be achieved
how a single goal is to be achieved

mc.q: Tactical plans are operational plans that identify ________.
o: how overall goals are to be achieved
specific goals for accomplishing a specific objective

mc.q: A politician whose ultimate goal is to get elected is planning campaign ads for TV. In planning the ads, the politician is functioning at a ________ level.
Directional plans ________.
Standing plans typically can be used ________.
o: only in conjunction with specific, long-term plans
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Standing plans are ongoing plans that guide activities performed repeatedly.

mc.q: Top managers, for the most part, focus on this type of planning.
The more uncertain a situation is, the more ________ plans must be.
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Under high uncertainty, plans must be flexible (directional) – note the textbook also says plans should be more short-term; "flexible" is the best fit for this wording.

mc.q: The commitment concept states that plans should ________.
o: always stake out a longer time period than is estimated
always stake out a shorter time period than is estimated
stake out a time period that is neither too long nor too short
not include time periods because they are too confining
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Commitment concept: plans should extend far enough to meet the commitments made today – too long or too short is inefficient/ineffective.

mc.q: Most managers feel that formal, top-down plans created by corporate planning departments are ________.
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Plans made by planning specialists were often ignored/unsatisfactory, so planning moved down to line managers.

mc.q: In the twenty-first century, managers increasingly need to consider their plans as ________.
o: highly explicit recipes that must be scrupulously followed
a vague philosophy that should not interfere with actions
flexible road maps with destinations that may change
rigid road maps with a single destination

mc.q: A cell phone company might ask managers to do some environmental scanning of blogs that deal with electronics as a way to ________.
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Environmental scanning = screening information to detect emerging trends.

mc.q: Which one of the following is NOT something that a company would be likely to do as a part of a competitive intelligence program?
o: buy stock in a competitor's company

mc.q: Formal planning typically leads to which one of the following?
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Formal planning is generally associated with positive financial results (higher profits, return on assets).

mc.q: Which one of the following defines the time frame of a long-term plan?
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Textbook: long-term plans have a time frame beyond three years; short-term plans one year or less.

mc.q: Planning is concerned with ________.
mc.note: Not marked on the sheet. Planning is concerned with ends (what) and means (how).

open: In a short essay, compare strategic plans and tactical plans.
In a short essay, define and discuss management by objectives (MBO).
